hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: The Numao, also known as Nu-hmou, is often subsumed under the same language as Bunu, as also reflected in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 in the entry Bu-Nao Bunu [bwx]. But Numao is not intelligible to Bunu (or Pou-nou, also subsumed in the same entry) and thus merits a separate language entry (**hh:s:Niederer:Changpaoyao**:216, **hh:s:Meng:Bunu**:149-192). I wish to thank Andrew Hsiu for bringing this case to my attention. See also: Bunu [bwx].
